HexKagune 1.0.41 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 51). Testing build.

- **Kaneki mutations removed:** Reach & Control, Auto Projectile, Centipede Body, Projectile Reflex Organ and Full Kakuja: Hunter are gone; old saves drop them.
- **Kaneki mutation quests removed:** Arrow Eater is gone, and Thousand Minus Seven now only opens the centipede form.
- **Kaneki revive passive:** Kaneki gets Furuta's "You Thought You'd Get Rid of Me That Easily?" (die and come back from the shreds) through the same quest as Furuta's (die 5 times, survive on the brink 3 times).
- **Ayato fifth mutation:** "You Thought You'd Get Rid of Me That Easily?" is added on top of his four mutations (needs 1000 mastery and the same quest); the other four are unchanged.
- **Kaneki menu:** the mutation board is replaced by a passive panel showing whether you have it or which quest gives it.
- **Ghoul skins:** wild ghouls wear 24 new skins (12 boys with wide arms, 12 girls with slim arms) in place of vanilla's default skins.
- **Ghoul names:** names now match the skin (boys' names for boys, girls' names for girls).
- **Ghoul kakugan:** the red eye opens right on each skin's eyes, taller on the girls, and on the eyepatch ghoul only the uncovered eye turns.
- **Ghoul flips:** wild ghouls back flip away when you crowd them and front flip in when you're too far off (base flips only, no big jump, each on a cooldown).
- **Ghoul dodges and counters:** ghouls see your M1 coming and either flip clear of it or, if they're a rinkaku with you in reach, swing back to clash with it.
- **Ghoul lancers:** half the rinkaku ghouls open by lashing from the full length of their tails.
- **Ghoul snipers:** a third of the ukaku ghouls keep 10 to 20 blocks back and snipe from up to 30 blocks with faster, harder shots.
- **Ghoul heavies:** rinkaku ghouls now have a right-click heavy (Owl's Execution); ukaku ghouls fire a storm of 7 shards in a fan.
- **NPC clash:** a ghoul's lash and your M1 meeting cancel both, with the same impact wind as PvP clashes.
- **Revive and King:** reviving now also ends any King ability you were in.
